title: Surprise accounting on a toy circuit: can outsiders reproduce ARC's heuristic-explanation cost on modular addition?

original_idea.body:
# Surprise Accounting on a Toy Circuit

Operationalize surprise accounting on the known modular-addition Fourier circuit; rank correct vs wrong explanations.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Strong chain: tests reproducibility/discriminativeness of ARC's surprise-accounting metric, a leading route to MAD.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Operationalizing surprise accounting needs solid theory/mech-interp; intermediate.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused: reproduce metric, compare correct vs wrong explanation on one known circuit.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Neglected independent reproduction of an ARC-internal metric, no lab resources, strong external value.

novelty.reasoning: Surprise accounting is barely demonstrated outside ARC; an independent reproduction is largely novel.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Surprise accounting reproduction outside ARC appears mostly novel.
